pages.title: Heart Chambers
pages.text: Heart Chambers are underground rooms in the Deepslate layer, covered in Tissue and centered around a $(l:blocks/beating_heart)$(c)$(o)Beating Heart$() in the middle. The main chamber features a pool of blood at its bottom and a Lover Spawner. The walkway leads to four additional chambers located at the sides. These rooms can contain various resources and Risus-related creatures.

pages.title: Heart Chamber Center
pages.text: Due to the challenge they pose, conquering them without a strategy is ill advised.
